newsitem.title: USA: Atchison to buy Citation foundry.
newsitem.headline: Atchison to buy Citation foundry.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp said Tuesday it agreed to purchase Pennsylvania Steel Foundry & Machine Co from Citation Corp for an undisclosed amount of cash.
Pennsylvania Steel, located in Hamburg, Pa., supplies carbon and high alloy steel castings to the power generation, valve and pump industries. Sales for the last 12 months were about $19 million.

Atchison, which also owns Empire Steel Castings Inc in Laureldale, Pa. and Quaker Alloy Inc in Myerstown, Pa., said the foundries will complement each other and create a strong presence in the Northeast.
The foundries have combined annual sales of more than $50 million and should help reduce costs and create improved performance, Atchison said in a statement.
Atchison produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings for a wide variety of equipment, capital goods and consumer markets.
Shares of Atchison were trading up 5/8 to 16-1/4.
